name: BLINK Covington Zone
summary: Located just across the Ohio River from Cincinnati, Covington offers a distinct blend of historic architecture, neighborhood charm, and urban convenience. The city is known for its beautifully preserved homes, vibrant local restaurant scene, and growing business districts. Areas such as MainStrasse and the riverfront combine a small-city feel with quick access to downtown Cincinnati, making Covington attractive to both young professionals and families. The community often feels more relaxed than downtown while still providing plenty of entertainment and cultural amenities.
details: Things to Do in Covington: https://www.visitcincy.com/neighborhoods/northern-kentucky/covington/
notes: lat/lng is the Nominatim point for the neighborhood/landmark name, not a BLINK-published zone centroid. "url" is the BLINK zone map page; the "Things to Do" link (Visit Cincy) is in details.

name: BLINK The Banks Zone
summary: The Banks area serves as the connection between downtown Cincinnati and the Ohio River, offering some of the region’s most recognizable public spaces and entertainment venues. Anchored by parks, sports stadiums, walking trails, and event spaces, the district attracts visitors year-round for concerts, festivals, and outdoor recreation. Modern development has transformed the riverfront into a vibrant destination where residents and tourists can enjoy waterfront views, dining, and easy access to both Cincinnati and Northern Kentucky.
details: Things to Do at the Banks: https://www.visitcincy.com/neighborhoods/downtown/the-banks/
notes: lat/lng is the Nominatim point for the neighborhood/landmark name, not a BLINK-published zone centroid. "url" is the BLINK zone map page; the "Things to Do" link (Visit Cincy) is in details.

name: BLINK Over-the-Rhine Zone
summary: Over-the-Rhine, commonly called OTR, is one of Cincinnati’s most distinctive and dynamic neighborhoods. Known for its extensive collection of 19th-century architecture, the area has undergone significant revitalization and now features trendy restaurants, cocktail bars, coffee shops, boutiques, and arts venues. The neighborhood combines historic urban character with a strong creative and entrepreneurial energy. OTR is often considered the cultural heart of the city, attracting residents and visitors who value walkability, nightlife, and a vibrant street scene.
details: Things to Do in OTR: https://www.visitcincy.com/neighborhoods/downtown/over-the-rhine/
notes: lat/lng is the Nominatim point for the neighborhood/landmark name, not a BLINK-published zone centroid. "url" is the BLINK zone map page; the "Things to Do" link (Visit Cincy) is in details.

name: BLINK Findlay Market Zone
summary: The Findlay Market area sits at the northern edge of Cincinnati’s urban core and blends historic character with a lively neighborhood feel. Centered around the city’s oldest continuously operated public market, the area is known for local food vendors, specialty shops, breweries, and community events. The surrounding streets feature a mix of restored historic buildings, new residential developments, and small businesses, creating an atmosphere that feels both authentic and evolving.
details: Things to Do in Findlay Market: https://www.visitcincy.com/neighborhoods/downtown/
notes: lat/lng is the Nominatim point for the neighborhood/landmark name, not a BLINK-published zone centroid. "url" is the BLINK zone map page; the "Things to Do" link (Visit Cincy) is in details.

name: BLINK Fountain District Zone
summary: The Fountain District centers on Fountain Square, Cincinnati’s traditional civic gathering place and one of the city’s most recognizable landmarks. Surrounded by office towers, hotels, restaurants, and entertainment venues, the district functions as the heart of downtown activity. The area hosts frequent concerts, seasonal events, and public gatherings, creating an energetic atmosphere throughout the year. It offers a polished, urban environment with convenient access to major employers, cultural institutions, and the broader downtown business district.
details: Things to Do in the Fountain District: https://www.visitcincy.com/neighborhoods/downtown/
